subject.title: Improve read tool handling for binary document formats (.docx, .pdf, .pptx, .xlsx) & Avoid Token Waste on Binary Read

question: Should this issue be fixed as a narrow read-tool unsupported-document fallback, as native core document extraction, or deferred to the broader document/file-input architecture issues?
rationale: The source-reproducible token-waste problem is real, but warning-only fallback, parser-based extraction, and provider-native file forwarding carry different core/tool/plugin and security boundaries.

options.title: Narrow Safe Fallback
options.body: Add a PDF/Office MIME and extension guard in the read tool that returns a clear unsupported-document message without parsing Office archives in core.

options.title: Approve Core Extraction
options.body: Define parser dependencies, archive/XML limits, sandbox behavior, and tests before adding native DOCX/PPTX/XLSX extraction to core.

options.title: Defer To File-Input Architecture
options.body: Keep this issue linked to the broader document extraction and provider-native file-input trackers until maintainers settle that architecture.

recommendation.title: Narrow Safe Fallback
recommendation.body: Add a PDF/Office MIME and extension guard in the read tool that returns a clear unsupported-document message without parsing Office archives in core.

likelyOwner.reason: The latest release history in this checkout ties Vincent Koc to the current read-wrapper, session read tool, and MIME helper surfaces.
